interfaces.name: Root air drying
interfaces.function: Assemble a reusable stone-and-bark tray, process actual roots and allow weather-dependent drying with reversible preservation while sufficiently dry.

Uncovered dry weather at 10–40 C removes at most 0.005 water mass per root per round to fraction 0.12; rain returns up to 0.01 per root, capped at original water. execution.progress: Exact personal processId, paid and remaining effort, reserved tool, actual separated mass and residual layer. Reissue peel with processId to resume. Other actions pause; cancel/death terminates without refund.
